highlights: Ugreen PB536 (55988B) 45W USB-C  PD 20000mAh Power Bank with Built-in Cable
This 45W power bank features a display that shows how much charge is left.
It supports fast charging standards: AFS (Samsung), Quick Charge 3.0, PowerDelivery, SCP (Huawei), and FAST Charge.
It's suitable for charging smartphones, tablets, headphones, laptops, smartwatches, and other gadgets.
maximum power per 1 USB-C port up to 45 W
equipped with 2 ports: 1x USB-A and 1x USB-C
equipped with a built-in USB-C cable
The display shows the battery charge level
